envelope.description: Implement lockfile export (requirementsPath generation) with faithful-export and version-uncertain gap detection

body.title: Implement lockfile export (requirementsPath generation) with faithful-export and version-uncertain gap detection
body.summary: For pipenv/poetry, generate a requirementsPath from Pipfile.lock/poetry.lock containing only plain-PyPI-sourced, faithfully-representable entries; a git/path/url-sourced or unfaithfully-representable entry is excluded and recorded as a non-standard-source gap (added to unresolvedDependencies). For plain pip, use the project's own requirements.txt directly; an entry that is not an exact pin is recorded as version-uncertain (also added to unresolvedDependencies), but the file itself is never rewritten. Every requirementsPath this step generates itself (pipenv/poetry only, never plain pip) is always paired with noDeps:true when later passed to pkgAuditTool (t1's fields).
acceptanceChecks: a poetry.lock entry with a git/path/url source is excluded from the generated file and recorded in unresolvedDependencies with a non-standard-source note
a poetry.lock entry with a plain PyPI source and exact version is included in the generated file (confirming the exact-locked version is preferred over a fresh resolution)
a plain pip requirements.txt entry using a version range (not an exact pin) is recorded in unresolvedDependencies as version-uncertain, while requirements.txt itself is left untouched
the generation step itself never sets noDeps -- that pairing happens at the collectDependencyAdvisories call site (t6)

tests.name: a poetry.lock entry with a git/path/url source -> excluded, added to unresolvedDependencies
a plain pip requirements.txt entry with a version range -> recorded in unresolvedDependencies as version-uncertain
a poetry.lock entry with an exact PyPI pin is included in the generated requirementsPath
